lessons.title: Chuyên đề 1: Phát âm
mcq: Trong bảng IPA, nguyên âm đóng vai trò giống phần nào của tiếng Việt?
Nguyên âm = phần vần, phụ âm = âm đầu: cat /kæt/ = k + æt.
Âm /ʌ/ trong cut thuộc nhóm chữ Việt nào?
Nhóm A có 3 âm: /æ/ cat – /ɑː/ cart – /ʌ/ cut.
Âm /ɜː/ trong bird thuộc nhóm nào?
Nhóm Ơ: /ə/ about (ơ nhẹ) – /ɜː/ bird (ơ dài).
Cặp nào là ngắn – dài của nhóm I?
Cùng một cột → chung đuôi i: say, boy, by.
Cặp “Trống – Mái” /f/ – /v/ khác nhau ở điểm nào?
Cùng khẩu hình răng – môi; /f/ chỉ có hơi, /v/ làm cổ rung.
Âm nào ở hàng cuối KHÔNG rung?
Hàng cuối không có cặp nên luôn RUNG — ngoại lệ duy nhất là /h/ (chỉ là hơi thở).
risks /rɪsks/ có mấy phụ âm đứng liền ở cuối?
s + k + s — tiếng Việt không có, phải đọc đủ cả 3, không nuốt.

lessons.title: Chuyên đề 3: Thì động từ
mcq: John ___ tennis once or twice a week.
Thói quen → hiện tại đơn; trạng từ tần suất đứng trước động từ thường.
Tom ___ his hand when he was cooking dinner.
Hành động ngắn xen vào hành động đang diễn ra → quá khứ đơn.
Jim is away on holiday. He ___ to Spain.
Theo đề gốc chọn has been. Lưu ý: nói chuẩn nhất cho người đang ở Tây Ban Nha là *has gone*, nhưng không có trong đáp án.
Everything is going well. We ___ any problems so far.
so far → hiện tại hoàn thành.
Jane ___ just a few minutes ago.
Timson ___ 13 films and I think the latest is the best.
Số lượng đạt được đến nay → hiện tại hoàn thành.
When I was a child, I ___ the violin.
Thói quen trong quá khứ → quá khứ đơn.
He ___ for the national team in 65 matches so far.
I'm busy at the moment. I ___ on the computer.
When I looked round the door, the baby ___ quietly.
Robert ___ ill for three weeks. He is still in the hospital.
Vẫn đang ốm (still) + for → hiện tại hoàn thành.
I'm very tired. I ___ over four hundred miles today.
What time ___ to work this morning?
Sáng nay đã qua → quá khứ đơn.
When I ___ this man, he was running away.
As soon as Martina saw the fire, she ___ the fire department.
Hai hành động nối tiếp ngay → quá khứ đơn.
Every time Parkas sees a movie made in India, he ___ homesick.
After the race ___, the celebration began.
After + quá khứ hoàn thành (bị động: had been V3).
The earth ___ on the sun for its heat and light.
Sự thật hiển nhiên → hiện tại đơn.
When I entered the room, everyone ___.
I was very tired because I ___ all the day.
Kéo dài cả ngày trước khi mệt (quá khứ) → QKHT tiếp diễn.
How long ___ able to drive? – Since 1990.
When she ___ the noise, she ___ down to the kitchen and ___ on the lights.
Chuỗi hành động nối tiếp trong quá khứ.
Every day, my sister ___ the floor.
After they ___ their breakfast, they ___ shopping yesterday.
Father ___ his pipe while mother ___ a magazine.
Hai hành động song song với while → quá khứ tiếp diễn.
When we came to the stadium, the match ___.

lessons.title: Chuyên đề 4: Sự phối hợp thì
mcq: I ___ your brother at Green Street yesterday afternoon.
He ___ a cigarette and ___ to the window.
Hai hành động nối tiếp trong quá khứ. light – lit/lighted đều đúng; chỉ C cùng thì.
After she ___ for help, she ___ off her shoes and ___ in to save him.
I can't go with you because I ___ my homework yet.
He ___ for London 2 years ago and since then I ___ him.
The performance ___ at 7 o'clock and ___ for 3 hours. We all ___ it very much.
Kể lại chuỗi sự việc nối tiếp → toàn quá khứ đơn.
Tell them to stop and take a rest. They ___ long enough.
Làm liên tục đến giờ (vẫn đang làm) → HTHT tiếp diễn.
“___ here before?” – “Yes, I ___ my holidays here last year.”
before (trải nghiệm) → HTHT; last year → QKĐ. spend – spent.
We ___ our housework by tomorrow evening.
by + mốc tương lai → tương lai hoàn thành.
“Your face is dirty, Tom.” – “All right, I ___ it.”
Quyết định ngay lúc nói → will.
Coming into the room, he ___ Mary where he ___ her.
Chia tay (left) xảy ra trước lúc gặp lại → QKHT.
I ___ from him since he ___ two years ago.
After the guests ___, she ___ back into the living-room and ___ off the light.
By the time you finish cooking, they ___ their homework.
“You have just missed the last train.” – “Never mind. I ___.”
“I ___ the way to the Globe Theater.” – “OK. I ___ you.”
don't know; am going to show
Come in, please. I ___ for you for long.
Who ___ to the cinema with last night?
Câu hỏi quá khứ đơn: did + S + V nguyên mẫu.
You ___ my sister for a long time. ___ come to see us tonight?
for a long time → HTHT; lời mời → Will you…?

lessons.title: Chuyên đề 5: Hoà hợp chủ ngữ – động từ
mcq: The trousers you bought for me ___ fit me.
Physics ___ my best subject at school.
Môn học có -s nhưng số ít.
Fortunately the news ___ as bad as we had expected.
news không đếm được → số ít.
The police ___ to interview Fred about a robbery.
Three days ___ long enough for a good holiday.
Khoảng thời gian là một khối → số ít.
Hỏi chỗ ở của các thành viên → số nhiều (tài liệu). *does* cũng gặp khi coi family là một khối.
England ___ lost all their football matches this season.
Theo tài liệu: tên nước → số ít. (Tiếng Anh–Anh hay coi đội tuyển là số nhiều: *England have…*)
___ the police know about the stolen money?
Can I borrow your scissors? Mine ___ sharp enough.
I'm going to take a taxi. Six miles ___ too far for me to walk.
John, along with twenty friends, ___ planning a party.
The picture of the soldiers ___ back a lot of memories.
N₁ of N₂ → theo the picture.
If the duties of these officers ___ reduced, there will not be enough time.
Advertisements on television ___ becoming more competitive than ever before.
Living expenses in this country, as well as in many others, ___ at an all-time high.
as well as → theo living expenses.
Mr. Jones, accompanied by several members of the committee, ___ proposed some changes.
The levels of intoxication ___ from subject to subject.
Neither Bill nor Mary ___ going to the play tonight.
neither…nor → theo danh từ gần nhất Mary.
Anything ___ better than going to another movie tonight.
Đại từ bất định → số ít.
Skating ___ becoming more popular every day.
V-ing làm chủ ngữ → số ít.

lessons.title: Chuyên đề 6: Động từ khuyết thiếu
mcq: You don't look well. You ___ see a doctor.
She ___ home yesterday because her little son was sick.
Lý do được nêu rõ (con ốm) → phải ở nhà → had to stay. Tài liệu chọn B (must have stayed – chắc hẳn đã ở nhà); giáo viên chọn C vì câu không phải suy đoán.
You ___ disturb him during his work!
Whose car is this? – It ___ be Anton's. I think I saw him driving a red car like this one.
Though he was ill and weak, he ___ get out of the burning building.
Xoay xở thành công 1 lần → was able to.
___ lending me your CD player for a couple of days?
Sau chỗ trống là lending (V-ing) → Would you mind + V-ing.
The windows look clean. You ___ wash them.
Không cần → needn't. (don't have to cũng mang nghĩa không cần; tài liệu chọn needn't.)
I don't believe it. It ___ be true.
Chắc chắn không → can't (không dùng mustn't để suy đoán).
Bổn phận → must (tài liệu). ought to cũng hợp nghĩa.
Jenny's engagement ring is enormous! It ___ have cost a fortune.
Có to phía sau → ought to.
“___ you hand me that pair of scissors, please?”
Nhờ người khác → Will you…? (shall chỉ đi với I/we).
Jeanette did very badly on the exam. She ___ harder.
Marcela didn't come to class yesterday. She ___ an accident.
John still hasn't come out. He ___ everything for the trip now.
now → suy đoán hiện tại: must be V-ing.
Thomas received a warning for speeding. He ___ so fast.
The photos are black. The X-ray at the airport ___ them.
Tom didn't do his homework, so the teacher became very angry. He ___ his homework.
My car stopped on the highway. It ___ out of gas.
“___ I be here by 6 o'clock?” – “No, you ___.”
Must I…? – No, you needn't (không cần).
“Where do you think Rooney is today?” “I have no idea. He ___ late.”
“I have no idea” → đoán không chắc → may have V3.
Barbate painted his bedroom black. It looks dark and dreary. He ___ a different color.
The children ___ “thank you” to you when you gave them their gifts.
If we had known your new address, we ___ to see you.
These two boys look identical. They ___ twins.
Suy đoán hiện tại → must be.
You've been working non-stop for ten hours. You ___ be really tired.
The fortune teller predicted that ___ inherit a big fortune before the end of this year.
Cần chủ ngữ + predicted (quá khứ) → she would.
I'm feeling very tired this morning. I ___ have stayed up late last night.
He helped her, but it was not necessary. He needn't ___ her.
“___ you like to play a game of tennis?” “I'd love to.”
His letter is full of mistakes. He ___ the mistakes carefully before sending it.
“I bought two bottles of milk.” “You ___ have bought milk; we have heaps of it in the house.”
When I first went to England, I ___ English, but I ___ it.
The car plunged into the river. The driver ___ out but the passengers were drowned.
I got lost and ___ ask a policeman the way.
We have some days off after the exam. ___ spend some time together?
You ___ ring the bell; I have a key.
Nobody knows how people first came to these islands. They ___ have sailed from South America.
She felt ill and ___ leave early.
The man was found unconscious at the foot of the cliff. He ___ have fallen 200 meters.
When the fog lifts, we ___ where we are.
The swimmer was very tired, but he ___ the shore before he collapsed.
If a letter comes for me, ___ you please forward it to this address.
I don't believe it. It ___ be true.
Laura, you and the kids just have dinner without waiting for me. I ___ work very late today.
Leave early so that you ___ miss the bus.
He was very lucky when he fell off the ladder. He ___ himself.
Đã có thể bị thương nhưng thực tế không → could have V3.
Robert arrived without his book. He ___ it.
Twenty years ago, David ___ speak Arabic fluently. Now he's forgotten a lot.
Jessica hasn't made up her mind about where to go to school. She ___ attend Duke University. She just doesn't know yet.
This box isn't as heavy as it looks. You ___ help me with it. Thanks anyway for offering to help.
Yesterday everyone in the office ___ leave the building for a fire drill. I am glad it wasn't a real fire.
Theo tài liệu chọn might. Câu tự nhiên nhất là *had to leave* (không có trong đáp án).
You ___ play loud music at night. The neighbors will call the police.
You ___ stand up. There are a lot of seats available on the bus.
People who use public parks ___ clean up after themselves.
This library book is overdue. I ___ better return it today.
Our company provides free advice on the use of our products. You ___ pay us.
Whatever ___ come, I will always be by your side.
Cụm cố định: whatever may come — dù chuyện gì xảy ra.
“___ you hand me that book, please?” “Sure. Here it is.”

lessons.title: Chuyên đề 7: Cụm động từ
words: I get up at 6 every morning.
It's cold outside. Put on your coat.
Turn off the TV before you go to bed.
Who will look after the children while you go out to work?
I have been looking for this book for months.
You can look up the new words in the dictionary.
You must fill in this application form.
Vietnamese people often do up their houses before Tet.
My father gave up smoking two years ago.
The plane took off one hour late.
Our car broke down on the way.
bùng nổ, bùng phát (cháy, chiến tranh)
Susan was alone in the house when the fire broke out.
I always run out of money before the end of the month.
Jack and Linda broke up last week.
Never put off until tomorrow what you can do today.
He puts aside some money every week.
mcq: It was the third time in six months that the bank had been held ___.
I always run ___ of money before the end of the month.
I've just spent two weeks looking ___ an aunt of mine who's been ill.
I've always got ___ well with old people.
get on well with: hoà hợp với.
It's very cold in here. Do you mind if I turn ___ the heating?
They've ___ a new tower where that old building used to be.
Stephen always wanted to be an actor when he ___ up.
The bus only stops here to ___ passengers.
If anything urgent comes ___, you can contact me at this number.
Your daughter's just started work, hasn't she? How's she getting ___?
We had to turn ___ their invitation to lunch as we had a previous appointment.
The elevator is not running today. It is ___ order.
I explained ___ him what it meant.
Who will ___ the children while you go out to work?
If you want to join this club, you must ___ this application form.
The water company will have to ___ off water supplies while repairs are carried out.
cut off: cắt (nguồn cung). Giáo viên viết lại các lựa chọn bị lỗi in trong tài liệu.
They were 30 minutes late because their car ___ down.
That problem is ___ them. We can't make ___ our mind yet.
be up to sb: tuỳ ai quyết · make up one's mind: quyết định.
Do you want to stop in this town, or shall we ___?
Please ___ the light, it's getting dark here.
The nurse has to ___ the patients at midnight.
Remember to ___ your shoes when you are in a Japanese house.
You can ___ the new words in the dictionary.
If you want to be healthy, you should ___ your bad habits.
Never put off until tomorrow what you can do today.
My father still hasn't really recovered from the death of my mother.
The bomb exploded with a loud bang which could be heard all over the town.
John, could you look after my handbag while I go out for a minute?
Why do they ___ talking about money all the time?
My father gave up smoking two years ago.
The government hopes to ___ its plans for introducing cable TV.
When the tenants failed to pay their bill, the authorities decided to ___ the gas supply to the flat.
You go on ahead and then I'll catch ___ you.
Both Ann and her sister look like her mother.
I'll be back in a minute, Jane. I just want to try out my new tape recorder.
The national curriculum is made ___ of the following subjects: English, Maths, Chemistry…
be made up of: được tạo thành từ.
Shy people often find it difficult to ___ group discussions.
“To give someone a ring” is to ___.
Because of heavy rain, the game was ___ for a few days.
What may happen if John will not arrive in time?
Johnny sometimes visits his grandparents in the countryside.
I do not use those things any more. You can ___ them away.
At the station, we often see the sign “___ for pickpockets”.
The passengers had to wait because the plane ___ off one hour late.
He ___ on many subjects at the meeting.
If I had not held him ___, he would have beaten you soundly.
Please let me ___. I promise not to do it again.
let off: tha thứ, bỏ qua.
He knows where the boy was hiding but he didn't let ___.
He promised to deliver the stuff today and has let us ___ again.
It seems that the rain is letting ___.
The traffic was held ___ by fog.
Because of the heavy rain, today the meeting will be held ___ until next week.
I would have been here sooner but the rain kept me ___.
It is most important to keep ___ your neighbors.
keep in with: giữ quan hệ tốt với.
He promised to keep ___ us while he was abroad.
I took ___ him at once, and we have been friends ever since.
take to sb: bắt đầu quý mến.
Our teacher told us that if we don't ___ the environment, our grandchildren may not be able to carry on living.
He may have deceived you, but he didn't take me ___.
I can't make ___ what he means.
They are all making ___ the exit.
We must make ___ some stories to explain our absence.
I ran ___ George in the library.
You need a rest; you look run ___.
He puts ___ some money every week.
Our dog has been run ___ by a car.
You may not like the noise, but you will have to put ___.
I promise to look ___ the matter.
The two countries have broken ___ relations.
We shall have to bring this matter ___ at the next meeting.
The new government has brought ___ many changes.
She used to be thin, but she has filled ___ a lot.
As I have just had a tooth ___, I am not allowed to eat or drink anything for three hours.
The woman ___ when the police told her that her son had died.
When Tet holiday comes, Vietnamese people often feel inclined to ___ their houses.
Bob has bad lung cancer and his doctor advised him to ___ smoking.
When he realized the police had spotted him, the man ___ the exit as quickly as possible.
The government is thinking of bringing ___ a law to make it compulsory for cyclists to wear crash helmets.
Susan was alone in the house when the fire ___.
I think you need to ___ your ideas more clearly so that the reader doesn't get confused.
Susie and Fran ___ us last night, so I had to quickly defrost a pizza.
Rebecca ___ on our conversation to tell us that James had just been rushed into hospital.
Is it compulsory that the scheme ___ next Friday?
Sau It is compulsory that… dùng be + V3 (giả định, bị động).
No one knows where Sam is living now. The last time that I ___ was about four years ago.
All his plans for starting his own business fell ___.
Whenever a problem ___, we try to discuss frankly and find solutions.
The computer isn't working – it broke ___ this morning.
The final year at secondary school is the time for teenagers to get ___ thinking about choosing jobs.
On Friday night, some of our friends came to the party and ___ for the weekend.
I have been looking ___ this book for months, and at last I have found it.
You can always ___ Ann to give you sound advice.
bank on = count on: tin cậy vào.
The new manager ___ very strict rules as soon as he had taken over the position.
Everyone knows about pollution problems, but not many people have ___ any solution.
The speaker fails to get his message ___ to his audience.
She is a friendly person. She gets ___ all her neighbors.
Jack and Linda ___ last week. They just weren't happy together.
Brian asked Judy ___ to dinner and a movie.
Her contract ___ in two months, so she's looking for another job.
I'm not sure my brother will ever get married because he hates the feeling of being ___.
It's a small lamp, so it doesn't ___ off much light.
When I joined the army, I found it difficult to ___ out orders from my superiors.
If too many species ___ out, it will upset the ecosystem.
It is very important for a firm or a company to keep ___ the changes in the market.
I'm saving all my pocket money ___ to buy a new PlayStation.
The effect of the painkiller is ___ and I begin to feel the soreness again.
Children should be taught that they have to ___ everything after they use it.
I can't walk in these high-heeled boots. I keep ___.
People are advised to ___ smoking because of its harm to their health.
It took Ted a long time to get ___ the breakup of his marriage.
The smell of the sea ___ his childhood.
Despite all the interruptions, he ___ with his work.
The new office block ___ well with its surroundings.
It's a serious operation for a woman as old as my grandmother. She's very frail. I hope she ___.
pull through: qua khỏi (bệnh nặng, ca mổ).
It was very difficult to ___ what he was saying because of the noise of the traffic.

lessons.title: Chuyên đề 8: Thức giả định
mcq: It is necessary that children ___ of their old parents.
It is necessary that + S + V nguyên mẫu.
I wish you ___ complaining about the weather.
Mong người khác thay đổi hành vi (gây khó chịu) → wish + would + V. Tài liệu chọn C (stopped); giáo viên chọn A vì đây là cách dùng chuẩn và tự nhiên nhất.
It is essential that every student ___ to learn English at university.
We wish we ___ a large house but we can't afford it now.
My friend won't lend me his car. I wish ___.
he didn't lend me his car
he would lend me his car
he will lend me his car
won't → ước tương lai/mong người khác thay đổi → would + V.
I'm sorry I haven't got any money on me. I wish ___.
I have got no money on me
I have some money on me
I had some money on me
I had got no money on me
My friends didn't take part in the game. I wish ___.
my friends took part in the game
my friends had taken part in the game
my friends would take part in the game
my friends did take part in the game
It wasn't fine yesterday. I wish ___.
I wish I ___ Psychology when I was a college student.
I wish someone ___ to help me with that work tomorrow.
If only I ___ play the guitar as well as you!
When I saw Tom, he looked ___ he had been ill.
Mrs White always talks to her baby as though he ___ an adult.
When he came out of the room, he looked ___ he had seen a ghost.
Susan's doctor insists ___ for a few days.
The doctor suggested that his patient ___.
It is necessary that he ___ the books.
It has been proposed that we ___ the topic.
It's important that every student ___ all the lectures.
He acts as if he ___ English perfectly.
She acted as though she ___ him before.
Câu chính quá khứ + before → QKHT.
I would rather that I ___ him to my birthday party yesterday.
She would rather Mary ___ here right now.
Trái thực tế hiện tại → were (văn nói có thể dùng was).
suggest that + S + (should) + V — cả A và B đều đúng.

lessons.title: Chuyên đề 9: Gerund & Infinitive
mcq: I think you should start practising now!
Tân ngữ sau start → danh từ.
Listening to music after work helps me relax my mind.
It's a waste of time playing computer games.
Theo tài liệu: cấu trúc waste time + V-ing → phân từ.
There are some people waiting to see you, Sir.
She thought of what he had said, smiling happily.
Rút gọn mệnh đề đồng thời.
My mother is in the sitting room.
The girl next door is playing the piano at the moment.
The thing I like best, chatting with friends, always makes me relaxed.
The man driving the red car is my husband.
Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ (who drives).
My sister said she was bored with doing the same things every day.
The book is so interesting that I can't put it down.
Feeling so hungry, I went down to the kitchen.
Rút gọn mệnh đề lý do.
When he was walking on the pavement, he ran into me.
The missing child was last seen playing near the river.
I found a coin lying on the sidewalk.
I couldn't help ___ at his jokes.
Tom offered ___ Jane a ticket to the theater, but she refused to take it.
Those workers stopped ___ their coffee because they felt tired of their work.
Dừng việc để uống cà phê → stop to V.
Mr Minh advised my family ___ leaving Vietnam.
advise sb against V-ing: khuyên ai không nên làm.
She wasted much time ___ her old pair of shoes.
He regrets ___ lazy last year. He lost his job.
She remembered ___ that woman last month.
David tried his best ___, but his girlfriend refused ___.
We heard a baby ___ in a neighbouring village.
Willy denied ___ a whole bag of chocolate chip cookies before lunch.
I was delighted ___ my old friends again.
We regret ___ you that we cannot approve your suggestion.
Have you ever considered ___ a pharmacist?
You had better ___ at home until you feel better.
I remember ___ my mother said the grass in the garden needed ___.
My teacher doesn't allow us ___ while he is explaining the lesson.
We have plenty of time. We needn't ___.
I promised ___ on time. I mustn't ___ late.

lessons.title: Chuyên đề 11: So sánh
mcq: In Vietnam, it is normally ___ in the South than in the North.
Có than; hot gấp đôi t.
The food is ___ than the last time I ate it.
Ho Chi Minh city is ___ than Hanoi.
Her voice is ___ than her sister's.
Her literature result is much ___ than it was last year.
Cinderella danced ___ than any other girls at the ball.
Bổ nghĩa cho danced → trạng từ, có than → more gracefully.
This book is the ___ of all.
Vật gây chán → boring; *the … of all* → most boring.
Không so sánh, chỉ cần trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho speaks.
Tom runs faster than John and David runs the ___ in the group.
There is nothing ___ than going swimming in hot weather.
She is ___ student in my class.
Tuan writes more ___ with fewer mistakes than the previous term.
Ít lỗi hơn → cẩn thận hơn, trạng từ cho writes.
My father is happy because I get ___ results at school.
Tính từ cho results, bố vui → good. (Tài liệu thiếu nhãn “B.” ở phương án good.)
Peter does better at school because he works ___.
He can do sums more ___ and read faster.
*fastly* không tồn tại; song song với *faster* → quickly.
She is a very ___ pupil. She spends most of her time studying.
My English this term is ___ than that of last year.
___ you study for these exams, ___ you will do.
The more hard / the more good
My neighbor is driving me mad! It seems that ___ it is at night, ___ he plays his music!
